scope: Durable context acknowledgement, bounded failures and resource closure through vendored Pipecat with controlled provider/storage/SFU leaves
cases: Transient assistant writes fail twice then recover before completion and follow-up on direct and SFU
Exhausted assistant writes stop after three attempts, send fatal error and clear, close through owner without callback deadlock, preserve saved history and block inference on direct and SFU
Exhausted user context save never starts inference or sends a recoverable retry message on direct and SFU
Failed final save still closes providers, transports and pipeline on direct and SFU
Timed-out cancellation-resistant write retains one owner and starts no overlapping retry
Interrupted write settles before newer snapshot
Durable Object does not assign an unacknowledged context snapshot
Failed final status write still closes control socket
limitations: Synthetic storage failures do not establish live Durable Object failure behavior
No live provider or physical playback claim
Supported installation remains a separate gate
